build.#files: The crate depends on ../zena-runtime, so its sources are inputs too. The workspace manifest and lockfile at the repo root pin every dependency version.
build.#output: The binary lands in the workspace target dir (../../target/release/zena-run); cargo tracks its own staleness, so wireit declares no output and only skips the script when no input changed.

test.#command: --release reuses the dependency artifacts the build step produced instead of compiling wasmtime a second time in the dev profile.
